title: Oven Roasted Mexican Tomato Tacos
description: Savory and fluffy tacos filled with roasted Mexican tomatoes and tempered chocolate, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped tomatoes with avocado oil, onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, and salt until they are evenly coated.
Spread the tomato mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the tomatoes are roasting, melt the dark chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Once the tomatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Temper the melted chocolate by stirring it constantly and letting it cool to around 82 degrees Fahrenheit.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the roasted tomatoes into the taco shells, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheese and a drizzle of tempered chocolate.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
Garnish with additional chopped onion, garlic, or cilantro if desired.
